nom: EltaMD UV Sheer Face and Body Sunscreen with Zinc Oxide

avis.texte: I highly recommend this sunscreen to anyone that can afford it and does not consider money an issue. It is an expensive sunscreen; however, during certain times of the year, such as Black Friday / Cyber Monday, you can find it discounted from its usual price. This product is marketed as a zinc oxide sheer sunscreen; however, it is a combination of a mineral and chemical sunscreen consisting of 15% Zinc Oxide and and 10% Octocrylene. In my opinion, this sunscreen does not need Octocrylene, as the percentage of Zinc Oxide it contains is already suitable and high enough for adequate protection against UVA-1, UVA-2 and UVB rays. Octocrylene is a chemical ingredient that protects only against UVB, which cause sunburn. This sunscreen goes on clear on the skin, leaving a minimal white cast, if any. It quickly absorbs into the skin. It leaves a minimal white cast on facial hair / a beard. It is very easy to apply to the skin without stretching it, including easy to apply to facial hair / a beard. My only recommendation when applying is to hold the tube upward, as some of the contents may leak out if the tube is facing downward. I recommend applying this product only to the face.

avis.titre: Amazing! Great for sensitive skin, doesn't feel greasy, and works perfectly under makeup!
avis.texte: I've been avoiding sunlight for decades, but occasionally it's inescapable. You'll never find me willingly soaking up the rays, but I do have to walk out to my car in summer, drive somewhere on my lunch hour, etc. I've gotten used to my foundation makeup having some SPF, but when I recently changed formulas, I was surprised to find zero mention of sun protection on the bottle. So off I went in search of a unicorn -- that is, a sunscreen that doesn't irritate my skin, doesn't affect the color or finish of my makeup, doesn't feel greasy, and doesn't smell like a day at the pool. I checked around the web for discussions about the best sunscreen to wear under makeup, and this EltaMD formula kept popping up. The price is definitely more than I would ever spend on something like this, but fortunately it's eligible for FSA, so I was able to put it on that account. I was a little worried about pilling because while some reviewers said it didn't pill at all, others said it pills badly. As for how it turned out for me... It's perfect. My skin is easily irritated, but I've been wearing this sunscreen daily for 6 weeks now, and my skin is happy. It's lightweight and feels like it moisturizes, so I use this instead of a moisturizer each morning, but it doesn't feel oily or greasy at all. It does have a little bit of a white cast to it, but that fades quickly and doesn't change the appearance of my foundation at all. And no, it doesn't make my foundation pill! avis.titre: Close but doesn’t hit the markClose but doesn’t hit the mark
avis.texte: This sunscreen is probably really good for other people but for me there are several reasons why I wouldn’t reach for it for my daily sunscreen. I will start with the positives -Initially dewy but dries matte!!! A sunscreen that will not make you feel oily (elta sport was wayyyy to shiny for me). Very clean matte finish. -No fragrance -Easy to apply. Grips skin but feels lightweight. I feel very adequately protected from the sun. -High UVA protection with high zinc oxide -water resistant (definetly feels that way) -no eye sting The cons -white cast :/ got my hopes high that it would be invisible or subtle as marketed but it is not. I am an olive toned person and the white cast was too strong for my liking. It initially goes on with a strong white cast that fades slightly after about 2-3 hours. Though there is a saying in the skincare community, any mineral sunscreen will always have a white cast. -Price but there is no surprise there. Elta Md positions themselves as the luxury drug store skin care brand. -The THD (vitamin c) irritates my skin upon application but fades. This is my second time trying to love an Elta Md sunscreen because I love love love hybrid sunscreen formulations. Currently my favorite American hybrid sunscreen is the jack black sun guard. That sunscreen has the most perfect finish, but I highly suspect it has the weakest UVA protection compared to any elta Md sunscreen. Overall I could see this being a holy grail for a pale, oily skin type person. Or anyon

I have been purchasing the tinted / UV clear face sunscreen from Elta md for years and I use it every day. I wanted to get somthing without the tint to apply to chest area (and face) when I don’t need the color coverage. I went back and forth debating which kind from Elta to get and this did not disappoint. Thinner consistency than the tinted cream but goes on smooth. Blends in with no white cast. And is great all day or under makeup with no dryness or issues. I am super obsessed!!!!!!

This is our favorite sunscreen. It’s not heavy, doesn’t look bad underneath makeup, protects the skin really well. This was the only face sunscreen I used during my trip to Europe where I was very much exposed to the sun. I also like that it’s a physical sunscreen. I highly recommend it, mostly if you don’t have a very oily skin.
This is a high quality sunscreen for face. My dermatologist recommended it. Not greasy. Goes on easy.
Best sunscreen I’ve ever used. Light weight and doesn’t sting my eyes.
Best sunscreen for my face! I’ve tried others, but I keep coming back because I haven’t found anything I like better!

I am brown toned and about a V on the pitzpatric scale and unfortunately this sheer UV leaves a definite white cast even after 10mins. I have dry skin and was hoping this light fluid would feel comfortable after my moisturiser but I found I had to reapply moisturiser on top again after a while as my skin felt a little tight. Unfortunately I won’t be using this during the day and will try to use it up during outdoor sports when I know it will be washed off soon after.

Recommended by a friend, I tried it as it is not greasy and suits my skin.

This elta MD sunscreen works exactly like it says. It’s lightweight lotion, comes out easily from the tube through a pointed hole for precise dispensing, rubs in easily, creates a sheen-like look at first, and then immediately absorbs into the skin leaving a matte finish. It made my hand look moisturized right away and no white cast from the get go. I’ve been using eltaMD almost every day now for couple months and it’s my go to for non irritating sun protection. I use their tinted one when I’m not going to put on any other makeup but want a little coverage, and I use this one when I’m going to run outside so want zero makeup and waterproof SPF, or going to put foundation over it. It holds up very well under makeup as well, and does not have any greasiness to it. It’s fragrance free, but I do smell a little bit of fresh scent in the lotion base. It is. Smaller tube, at 1.7 ounce, something to note for purchase decision. Made in USA.

When I read that the ingredients included zinc oxide, I though that this sunscreen would turn my face white like a mime. It did not do that. The white cream that came out of the 50 ml, 1.7 ounce, tube of EltaMD UV Sheer Face Sunscreen quickly turned transparent when I rubbed it onto the back of my hand. This sunscreen combines the metallic oxide, zinc oxide, sun blocker with an organic sun blocker to produce an SPF 50 sunscreen. This will be used outdoors as soon as we see the return of the summer sun.

I have been using this sunscreen for a few weeks and I really like it. It goes on smoothly and doesn’t feel sticky. Plays well under makeup. The spf 50 helps protect my skin from the sun. The zinc dries transparent on my skin. I will continue to use this and would recommend it.
I love elta sunscreen products. No problem but the package was crushed. Not acceptable Amazon. Especially for such a high price. Do better.

avis.titre: UV Sheer vs Sport vs Shield (old)
avis.texte: This is a review for Elta MD UV Sheer vs UV Sport vs UV Shield, which was the old product that I was trying to replace but is unfortunately discontinued. See photos for the three tubes and their ingredients in the back (same order left to right). Ingredient wise, the UV Sport is probably closer to the Shield. Consistency wise, the Sheer is the most watery, the Shield is in middle, and the Sport is the thickest. I really loved the Shield. It was very annoying when a favorite product is somehow discontinued. I got both Sheer and Sport to try. To my surprise, I actually prefer the Sheer, which is a good product for everyday use. I had worries based on other reviews that it could be too watery. So far, I’ve kept the tube standing up, with the cap tightly closed. I also am careful when I squeeze out the content. No accidental spillage so far. It goes on my face lightweight and easy to apply. It should be noted that the scent is noticeable— a typical “unscented” sunscreen scent. It goes away after a while but much more noticeable than Shield. The Sport is a good summer or sport sunscreen. The consistency is definitely heavy, so it doesn’t work well as an everyday sunscreen for me during the winter months. But I am keeping it for summer and heavy sweaty workout sessions. Surprising, I like both Sheer and Sport for different reasons and will be keeping both. Maybe they’ll bring back Shield?! Hope this is a helpful review for those of you who are in the same boat of trying to replace

I really wanted to like this but it did not work for me. It left a noticeable cast on my skin especially in photos. It also caused weird spots on my face to dry out. The texture of the sunscreen was nice but I wouldn't recommend this unless you're super pale and super oily. For this price, I'd recommend skin aqua super moisture milk over this. That one is usually less than $20. This eltamd is not worth it.

The bottle i received was in flimsy packaging and the bottle was thinner than normal with no safety seal. I scanned QR code at the bottom and it came up as Elizabeth Taylor’s white diamonds. Returning as I feel it is a fake. I will be buying directly from the elta MD website from now on.

The small tube is runny and hard to keep on your fingers while trying to reach your face. I think it may have been exposed to heat. Very disappointing, especially for the price.

EltaMD UV Sheer Face Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 50+ is claimed to be Water Resistant, Mineral Based Sun Protection, Non Greasy, Lightweight Daily Oil Free Zinc Oxide Sunscreen Lotion. Here are my thoughts below, Pros, - non irritating : doesn’t make me tear even applying bear eye lids, eye area - non greasy - non whitening looking : some sunscreen makes my face very powdery, looking like white clown but this sunscreen did great job on blending into my skin tone. - good daily sunscreen even under makeup - nice tube applications for liquid constancy Cons - Dry : although the sunscreen is moisturizing feeling when I apply soon later my face feels slightly dry (your face looks shiny after applying the sunscreen but I think it’s a good thing because my face looks heathy and glowy from it in my option) - high price, $30 - not advertising full ingredients on their page. : I tried to find all the ingredients other than key, active ingredients I simply couldn’t find - doesn’t feel like protecting from sun : I applied this sunscreen before gardening. I still got some redness after being outside. (Apply frequently of course) Overall, I like this sunscreen because this sunscreen has no white cast, no dry pasty texture and goes on nice and smooth. But, the price is higher than other products on the market.

avis.titre: Lightweight Lotion, But Leaves Me Shiny and Takes Effort To Rub In
avis.texte: The EltaMD (non-tinted) Sheer Face SPF 50+ is an overall great sunscreen. It comes in a small 1.7oz tube. The white, watergel like texture is lightweight and near odorless. Seems very hydrating. I am over 40, a natural redhead (who is prone to burn, not tan), with sensitive, combination, acne-prone skin. This particular version of EltaMD’s spf is not my favorite though, as this one leaves me looking a hint shiny and does take a little effort to avoid white cast (having to massage it in more thoroughly than what I’m used to). I will likely finish the bottle and move along to EltaMD’s tinted version of this sunscreen. For whatever reason, for me, it has better spreadability and doesn’t leave me looking oily or shiny. That is not to say there is anything wrong with this SPF. I like that it has a high % of zinc oxide (physical blockers) and doesn’t have the telltale old school sunscreen smell of my youth. I also understand zinc oxide is often the culprits for white cast as it requires being milled extra fine. I just don’t want to appear glossy or glowy. I think this is better suited for users with more dry complexions; and (generally) those with sensitive skin.

I don’t know why it’s so hard to find a non greasy sunscreen. Have tried mattifying ones that LOOK powdery but never dry and come off on my clothes. Decided to try this elta md formulation since oily skinned folks like it. I can say that it doesn’t FEEL greasy. However. Even after an hour and a half of letting this stuff absorb I look like a ball of grease. Mind you this is after washing my face and I’m not super oily to start with, just have an oil prone T zone. This oil slick on my face is all elta md not natural face oil. I can’t believe it.

I re-ordered this sunscreen, and it came in a significantly smaller container than the original (despite being labeled the same amount). You can see from the picture that it is much slimmer, and it's not any taller. I love EltaMD, but this felt like a total rip-off.

I still think this is an excellent product, but I noticed a couple of things when I purchased a couple of new tubes recently (5/2022). First, the product that I have been using (on the left) I couldn't find anymore. So, I opted to purchase the version on the right. It's equally light weight and comfortable to wear under my makeup, for about the same price as I am accustomed to paying. The particularly interesting thing is the packaging. Notice that both tubes reference "3 oz" and a metric number of "85" However, upon closer inspection, note that it's now "3 FLUID oz" instead of the previous 3 oz weight measurement and "85 MILLILITERS" instead of the previous 85 grams. So, the numbers are the same, but the volume of product that is in the container (for the same price as the larger container) is smaller. Maybe the newly purchased product is actually lighter in weight than the previuos product and a weight measurement is more accurate than a volume measurement. If it is an effort to veil the reduction in amount of product for the same price, I think Elta gets bonus points for handling pricing inflation so cleverly.

avis.titre: Good product but not happy with expy date
avis.texte: Wonderful product except when I most recently ordered it they sent one that expires in a couple of months. Honestly for this price point I think they need better quality control because others that I’ve bought didn’t expire so quickly

avis.titre: Too thin; causes skin that comes in contact with gold to turn black
avis.texte: I loved the cream formula in the jar. This solution (a lotion) is thin and runny, not very emoilient and causes the skin under my 14K wedding ring turn black. My dermatologist at M. D. Anderson Cancer Center recommended Elta, as it was a fragrance-free, noncomedogenic, effective sunscreen. I used the cream formula for several years, and not only was it much more emollient, this discoloration never occurred. Sadly, I don't think I'll be reordering Elta again.

avis.titre: I will write two separate paragraphs about the sunscreen and the seal
avis.texte: 1) Sunscreen - Has a mild fragrance . Goes on smoothly and doesn’t leave a cast. It is not THICK like La Roche Posay Anthelios which is too heavy for me. I experience extreme balling/pilling with the UV Clear 46 by Elta MD but this one (UV SHEER 50+) seems to not pill as much. Will update after I have finished this entire container. 2) The tube arrived in an open box and there was no foil/seal on the tube or the box. I do not feel comfortable ordering my regular supply because there’s no way of knowing if someone else used it or tampered with it. Hard pass.
Box looked as if had been previously opened, assuming contents are ok but no safety seal so can’t be sure
